thread:
sam: Heads up — planning a coordinated cutover tonight 22:00 UTC. Need API, runtime, router, console to move together. Change window 22:00-23:30 UTC. Proposal: pin router -> v3.1.2, runtime -> r-2026-03-20, api -> api-2.8. Rollout order suggestion: console (read-only), runtime, router, then API traffic shift. Canary 10% for 15m, then 50% for 15m, then full. Anyone object? :wave:

anya: OK on the runtime pin. Two notes: 1) KV cache schema change in r-2026-03-20 — we'll need a warmup job before routing traffic, otherwise p99 spikes. 2) If we see KV miss amplification, we should pause router traffic shift and drop to previous runtime.

matt: API side good for pin. We'll flip feature flags to disable new streaming path until router + runtime are stable. Also will hold back embedding dense-index rollout until after full traffic.

leila: Console can go read-only first. We'll push a small UI banner and disable write actions. Also will freeze platform metrics exporters for 10m during canary to avoid noisy alerts. Suggest canary window 10% x 15m, as sam suggested.

sam: Rollback criteria proposal: - error_rate (5xx) > 0.8% sustained over 5m OR - p50 latency regresses > 50ms and p95 > 250ms OR - KV miss amplification > 3x baseline. If any triggered, immediate traffic pause and roll runtime back to r-2026-03-13. Agreed?

anya: agreed on metrics. Add a soft guard: if deploy-bot marks infra warning (memory or OOM) auto-red alert and pause. We'll also run cache-warm job: `kubectl exec job/cache-warm --namespace=runtime -- ./warm.sh` before the router shift.

matt: I'll prepare API rollforward and rollback playbooks and push to /releases/2091234567 in the repo. Also adding a health-check endpoint to verify kv hits: `GET /health?check=kv` returns {"kv_hit_rate": "0.91"}.

deploy-bot: deploy-schedule created by @sam for 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z, id=deploy-2091234567. Preflight checks: config pinned, canary policy set (10/50), alert hooks present.

leila: small reminder — console release notes need to mention read-only mode and known degraded telemetry. I'll post a short blurb to #announcements at T+30 once canary passes.

sam: final check: CI artifacts built? matt/anya confirm binary hashes and docker tags. If green, we start preflight at 21:30 UTC for config validation and warmups.

matt: images pushed. API tag api-2.8 -> sha256:ab12...cd34. Feature flags staged.

anya: runtime image pushed r-2026-03-20 -> sha256:ef56...gh78. Starting cache-warm dry-run at 21:35.

deploy-bot: preflight completed at 2026-03-20T21:42:00Z — all checks green except a single non-fatal lint warning in console docs.

sam: thanks everyone. We'll meet in #eng-releases voice at 21:50 for final go/no-go. If anything else, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
